description: Turn up to 12 planned videos into realistic shoot days: bundled by place, split evenly (max 3 shoots, 8 h), with set-up, breaks, lunch, timed schedule, equipment list, checklist and optional .ics files. Returns: JSON with language, rules, summary, days, warnings, coverage. PAID: 0.03 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing. NOTE: Rule-based, German labels, no AI model. Do not send names or other personal data: only video titles, place labels and equipment. Results are kept 30 days like all results. Nothing is written to a calendar; calendar files are text you import yourself.

first_date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD of the first shoot day; adds calendar files. Further days follow every second day.

location.description: Place label, e.g. Showroom. Same labels are grouped on one day.

minutes.description: Pure recording minutes. Default: recipe time or 40.

recipe_id.description: Optional recipe id from video-recipes: supplies duration, set-up type, equipment and follow-up formats.

title.description: Short name of the video, e.g. Product in 30 seconds. Do not put personal data here.

name: shoot_day_plan
